name: Michalis Hadjipantela - § 16 - Am 10
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text: 16.Takes note thattheoverall budget for the renovation of the Spaak building has been set at EUR 455 million and that EUR 77,67 million are foreseen for 2027; underlinesthat these costs are not included in the budget 2027; stresses the need to ensure strict cost control, transparency and adherence to the planned budget; is sceptical that the renovation of a single, already fully functioning building, should cost close to EUR 0,5 billion; demands a reduction in the costs of this undertaking; demands full transparency and the tracking of all expenses related to this undertaking to ensure accountability for those responsible for potential financial irregularities; expresses concern at the absence of a detailed breakdown of costs for the planned renovation of the Spaak building, decided by the Bureau of the European Parliament; underlines that such a lack of transparency is particularly problematic for a project of this scale and raises concerns about possible cost overruns, especially in light of those observed in several previous European construction projects, such as Berlaymont, the Europa building, the Court of Justice, EMA, KAD II;
